comments.quote: 環境差是指噪音大 就這個價位來説房間還可以 但有個致命的缺點 店家養了衹狗 養在對面的山上 一直叫 房門關着也像在耳邊叫 店家一家可能天天聽習慣了也不制止 但是作為出來旅遊散心的我來説 房間外有衹狗一直叫我可真受不了 這次民宿住得可真是花錢買罪受 所以住了幾個小時沒到晚上就提前走了 狗不懂事不怪狗 人好歹制止一下吧 狗一天到晚被拴在山上活動範圍沒有一米遠 真也挺可憐的 這樣養狗在我看來就是虐待狗 不愛狗可以不養的 養了就別這樣虐待
comments.author: Anonymous User
comments.quoteEn: By poor setting I mean the noise. For this price the room is fine, but there is one fatal problem: they keep a dog tied up on the hill opposite and it barks constantly. With the door shut it still sounds like it is next to your ear. The family have presumably stopped hearing it and do nothing about it, but as somebody who came here to unwind I could not stand a dog barking outside my room. I paid for the privilege of being tormented and left a few hours in, before nightfall. It is not the dog's fault, but somebody could stop it. It is tied up on a hillside with less than a metre to move in, which is pitiful. To me that is not keeping a dog, it is mistreating one. Nobody has to keep a dog.
